title: 第三章 设计第四章 煽风点火
slug: 诸天影视从四合院开始
content_zh:
叶晨嘿嘿一笑，看了娄小娥一眼，然后开口说道：
“嫂子，我想求你个事儿！”
娄小娥看着脸色蜡黄的叶晨，感觉这家伙有些可怜，开口说道：
“兄弟你有事儿就说，嫂子能办到的绝对不会含糊。”
“前些日子我看你家大茂下乡去给人家放电影，别人送了他几只老母鸡，嫂子你能不能匀我一只？现在市场上一只一块五到两块钱左右，你家的老母鸡指着它下蛋的话，我给你五块，我这身体感觉有些发飘，去市场往回拎太远了，我想给自己炖只老母鸡，喝些鸡汤补一补，你看行吗？”
娄小娥想了想，然后对着叶晨开口说道：
“成，那我回去跟大茂说一声，相信他看在钱的份上也会答应，用不用我帮你在家熬好？”
娄小娥担心叶晨这么一个光棍儿，哪怕是买回去，也不知道怎么熬。
叶晨笑了笑，然后开口说道：
“那倒是不用，嫂子，我在家自己熬就成，你给我挑只壮点儿的，我自己在家收拾。”
娄小娥笑了笑，看了眼叶晨开口说道：
“放心吧，不看别的，就冲你小子这么实在，嫂子也会给你挑只最好的，送到你屋去，我刚问过医生，这瓶吊瓶打完，你就能回家了，我先回家看看，给你挑只鸡去。”
“好的，嫂子，您有事儿就先去忙，不用管我，我打完吊瓶自己回去就好。”
叶晨回道。
目送娄小娥出了病房，叶晨笑了笑，傻猪，你不是能帮秦寡妇扛事儿吗？这回你扛吧，我给你打个样儿，一只老母鸡五块，三倍赔偿，不把你这孙子半个月工资给你折进去才怪，我看你在你妹妹雨水那边怎么交代！
吊瓶打的差不多了，叶晨自己揭开了手上的胶布，拔下了针头，用手上的酒精棉按了会儿针眼，看看不再流血了，起身离开了病房。
叶晨跟护士打了声招呼，然后朝着自己的车间走去，回到车间的时候，已经差不多到了下班的时间，自己的师父正在收拾车床，准备下班，叶晨赶忙上前，开口说道：
“师父，让我来吧，你去洗洗，然后换身儿衣服，不好意思啊，今天在食堂打饭的时候，突然晕倒了，在医院打了一下午的吊瓶。”
带叶晨的师父老马看了眼叶晨，然后开口说道：
“你去看医生，医生是咋说的？没什么大毛病吧？”

“就是营养不良导致的贫血，不是什么大毛病，多吃点好的就有了。”
叶晨接过了师父手中擦车床的棉纱，开口说道。
老马看了一眼自己的徒弟，开口说道：
“臭小子，老叶过世之前，把你交到了我手里，千叮万嘱，让我一定照顾好你，可你呢？自己都不爱惜自己，明个去我家里，我让你师娘给你做点好吃的补补，瞧你这小脸蜡黄的，你师娘看见了非骂我不可，我可告诉你，你不让我在我媳妇那里好过，我也可会惯着你的，我是你师父，折磨你的招儿有的是，你掂量着来！”
叶晨看着自己的师父，突然间一股暖流涌上心头，自己在现实世界的时候，从来都是无依无靠，来到了这里，本来以为只不过是延续以前的生活，没想到这个世上还有真的关心自己的人，叶晨沉默了一会儿，然后开口说道：
“师父，你放心，我以后不会再这样了，你赶紧去洗洗，然后回去吧，我收拾完就回去，明天去你家里看你和师娘去。”
老马点了点头，找了块干抹布擦了擦手，然后转身离开。
叶晨则拿起了手中沾着柴油的棉纱，将机器上的污渍仔细的擦了起来，擦完之后，叶晨找了个油纸袋将棉纱装了进去，然后往里面倒了点机油，这才去洗漱，准备下班。
傻柱将食堂的后灶打扫干净，正要拎着饭盒下班儿，突然就看见棒梗拿着个玻璃瓶子，在偷食堂的酱油，傻柱笑了笑，吓唬了棒梗一声，棒梗跟个地耗子似的，急忙往外面钻去，傻柱顺手抄起了根擀面杖，朝着门口的方向砸去，赶巧许大茂正从外面进来，擀面杖砸了许大茂一个正着，气的许大茂脸都紫了，两个人逗了会磕子，许大茂憋着口气离开。
傻柱则是滴拉着自己的饭盒朝着单位的门口走去，天寒了，他准备给妹妹何雨水煲点汤喝。
傻柱走到院门口方向的时候，突然闻到了一股子香味儿，作为一个厨子，他对这味儿可不陌生，他挨个水泥管子望去，最后发现是秦寡妇家的棒梗带着两个妹妹在那里烤鸡吃呢，傻柱一看就知道这鸡是棒梗这小混蛋不知道搁哪偷来的，反正也不是偷自己的，活该被偷的倒霉蛋，傻柱逗弄了一会儿棒梗和小当，槐花，起身离去。
棒梗捧着个鸡骨架，啃着正香的时候，就感觉自己的脑袋被什么东西给砸了一下，没等他反应过来，就见一个东西掉进了刚才他们三个烤鸡的火堆里……
“傻柱！”
，傻柱刚走到院门口，就听见身后有人喊他，他回头一看，是和自己住一个四合院儿的老叶家的小子，平时不吱声不吱语的，文静的跟个姑娘似的，傻柱回头骂道：
“叶晨，我看你小子皮子痒了是吧？傻柱也是你叫的？喊我干嘛？”
叶晨看着傻柱一脸的不爽，微微一笑，然后开口说道：
“把你家砂锅借我用用成吗？我买了只老母鸡，打算晚上给炖了，家里没合适的炊具。”
“今晚不行，砂锅我今晚也要用，这样吧，明天的，明天用完了你过来拿。”
傻柱寻思了一下，开口说道。
“成，那我先谢谢了，有工夫一起整两盅！”

叶晨笑着回道。
傻柱应了一声，朝着家的方向走去，叶晨看着傻柱离去的背影，笑了笑，今晚你这家伙有事儿干了，这口黑锅不让你背到这个月吃土，我这个叶字都倒过来写。
娄小娥回到家，直接奔着鸡笼子而去，结果发现笼子里的老母鸡只剩下一只了，正巧这时许大茂从外面拎着包回来，娄小娥对着许大茂开口说道：
“大茂，咱家鸡丢了一只！”

content_en:
Ye Chen chuckled, glanced at Lou Xiao'e, and then said:
"Sister-in-law, I want to ask you for a favor!"
Lou Xiao'e looked at Ye Chen, whose face was sallow, and felt that this guy was a little pitiful, so she said:
"Brother, if you have something to say, just tell me. My sister-in-law will never be vague about anything she can do."
"A few days ago, I saw your Damao go to the countryside to show a movie for others. Someone gave him a few old hens. Sister-in-law, can you give me one? Each one on the market costs about one yuan, five to two yuan. If your old hens point to it and lay eggs, I will give you five yuan. My body feels a little shaky. It's too far to carry it back to the market. I want to stew an old hen for myself and drink some chicken soup to replenish it. Do you think it's okay?"
Lou Xiao'e thought for a while, then said to Ye Chen:
"Sure, then I'll go back and talk to Damao. I believe he will agree for the sake of money. Do you need me to help you get through it at home?"
Lou Xiao'e was worried that Ye Chen, a bachelor like him, wouldn't know how to survive even if he bought it back.
Ye Chen smiled and then said:
"That's not necessary, sister-in-law, I can handle it at home. You can pick a stronger one for me and I can take care of it myself at home."
Lou Xiao'e smiled, glanced at Ye Chen and said:
"Don't worry. I don't care about anything else. I'm just being honest with you. My sister-in-law will also pick the best one for you and send it to your house. I just asked the doctor that after this bottle is finished, you can go home. I'll go home first and pick a chicken for you."
"Okay, sister-in-law, if you have anything to do, go ahead and do your work. Don't worry about me. I'll just go back after filling the bottle."
Ye Chen replied.
Seeing Lou Xiao'e out of the ward, Ye Chen smiled, Silly Pig, can't you help Widow Qin with her affairs? You carry it this time, I'll give you something like, five yuan for an old hen, three times the compensation, it would be weird not to give you half a month's salary of your grandson, I'll see how you explain it to your sister Yuyu!
The bottle was almost done. Ye Chen took off the tape on his hand, pulled out the needle, pressed the eye of the needle with the alcohol cotton on his hand for a while to see if there was no more bleeding, then got up and left the ward.
Ye Chen said hello to the nurse and then walked towards his workshop. When he returned to the workshop, it was almost time to get off work. His master was packing up the lathe and getting ready to get off work. Ye Chen hurried forward and said:
"Master, let me do it. You go wash up and change your clothes. I'm sorry, but I suddenly fainted while eating in the cafeteria today. I spent the whole afternoon in the hospital with a sling."
Lao Ma, the master who was taking care of Ye Chen, looked at Ye Chen and then said:
"You went to the doctor. What did the doctor say? There's nothing serious, right?"
"It's just anemia caused by malnutrition. It's not a big problem. Just eat more good things and you'll be fine."
Ye Chen took the cotton yarn used to clean the lathe from his master and said.
Lao Ma glanced at his apprentice and said:
"You brat, before Lao Ye passed away, he handed you into my hands and told me to take good care of you. But what about you? You don't even care about yourself. Go to my house tomorrow and I'll ask your wife to make you some delicious tonic. Look. You have such a sallow face, and your master wife will scold me when she sees it. Let me tell you, if you don’t let me have an easy time with my wife, I will spoil you. I am your master, and I have many ways to torture you. You have to think of it!”
Ye Chen looked at his master, and suddenly a warm feeling came to his heart. When he was in the real world, he was always helpless. When he came here, he thought he was just continuing his previous life. He didn't expect that there were people who really cared about him in this world. Ye Chen was silent for a while, and then said:
"Master, don't worry, I won't do this again. You go and wash up quickly, and then go back. I will go back after cleaning up. I will go to your home to see you and my wife tomorrow."
Old horse pointHe nodded, found a dry rag and wiped his hands, then turned and left.
Ye Chen picked up the cotton gauze stained with diesel in his hand and carefully wiped the stains on the machine. After wiping, Ye Chen found an oil paper bag and put the gauze in it, then poured some engine oil into it, then went to wash up and prepare to get off work.
Silly Zhu cleaned the back stove of the cafeteria and was about to get off work with his lunch box. Suddenly he saw Banggeng holding a glass bottle and stealing soy sauce from the cafeteria. Silly Zhu smiled and scared Banggeng. Banggeng hurriedly went outside like a rat. Silly Zhu picked up a rolling pin and threw it towards the door. Xu Damao happened to be coming in from the outside. The rolling pin hit Xu Damao. Xu Damao's face turned purple with anger. The two of them bumped into each other for a while, and Xu Damao left holding his breath.
Silly Zhu pulled his lunch box and walked towards the door of the unit. It was getting cold, so he was going to make some soup for his sister He Yuyu.
When Sha Zhu walked towards the entrance of the courtyard, he suddenly smelled a scent. As a cook, he was no stranger to this smell. He looked at the cement pipes one by one, and finally found out that it was Widow Qin's Banggeng who was there with his two sisters. They were eating roasted chicken. Silly Zhu knew at a glance that the chicken was Banggeng. The little bastard had stolen it from somewhere. Anyway, he didn’t steal it from himself. He deserved to be stolen. Silly Zhu teased Banggeng and Xiaodang, Huaihua for a while, then got up and left.
Banggeng was holding a chicken skeleton and chewing Zhengxiang when he felt his head was hit by something. Before he could react, something fell into the fire where the three of them were roasting chicken...
"Silly pillar!"
As soon as Sha Zhu walked to the door of the courtyard, he heard someone calling him from behind. He turned around and saw that it was a boy from the old Ye family who lived in the same courtyard as him. He was usually silent and as quiet as a girl. Sha Zhu turned around and cursed:
"Ye Chen, I think your skin is itchy, right? You called me Silly Zhu too? Why are you calling me?"
Ye Chen looked at Sha Zhu's unhappy face, smiled slightly, and then said:
"Can you lend me your casserole? I bought an old hen and plan to stew it tonight. I don't have any suitable cooking utensils at home."
"Not tonight, I need to use the casserole tonight too. Let's do it tomorrow. Come and get it when you're done tomorrow."
Silly Zhu thought for a moment and said.
"Okay, thank you in advance. Let's make two cups together when we have time!"
Ye Chen replied with a smile.
Silly Zhu responded and walked towards home. Ye Chen looked at Silly Zhu's leaving figure and smiled, "You guys have something to do tonight. I won't let you bear this blame until this month. I will write the word "leaf" upside down.
Lou Xiao'e returned home and went straight to the chicken cage, only to find that there was only one old hen left in the cage. It happened that Xu Damao came back from outside carrying a bag. Lou Xiao'e said to Xu Damao:
"Da Mao, we lost one of our chickens!"
